what_happened: Found an exact, already-proven precedent (hooks/validate-handoff-location.sh) for the write-time enforcement mechanism, and an exact existing durable-trace template (HANDOFF_STALE_OR_ABSENT recorder block) to copy verbatim for the postflight-side fix -- no novel mechanism had to be designed.

Research report 01 pre-settled the (i)/(ii) choice, the mechanism, the attribution rule and both WARN rulings with verified file:line citations, so planning needed only targeted re-verification (3 greps, 6 reads) rather than independent derivation. One refinement was found during that re-verification: the recommended handoff_valid fourth stdout token would have silently corrupted plan_markers_verified at all three suffix-stripping call sites, so the plan relocates the validator call instead.
